note: What FIRN-01's sensors make out in a simulation. Two things are in here. The maker's rulings: which sensors he carries, that they reach as a scout's do, what silent running, his own smoke and a thin wall do to them, and what they may tell him about a person (SKILL.md section 2). And house rules: every figure, for when the brief gives none. Game mechanics only; they model no real sensor. The figures are yours to edit, and a brief that names its own outranks them.
label: house rules, November 2026

detect.thing: something is there: a bearing and a range, nothing more
detect.living: something alive is there: a bearing and a range, nothing more

classify.thing: what kind of thing it is: a vehicle, an armour, a drone, an aircraft, a building
classify.living: a person or an animal, and how many

identify.thing: which one: its type and markings, whether it is armed, and whose it is if that shows
identify.living: what they are doing and carrying: standing, moving or down, armed or not; and who they are, if he has met them or has them on file

read.thing: its state: heat, damage, load, how many are aboard, what it is doing
read.living: their state: whether they move and breathe, warm or cooling, hurt or not

edge.note: inside half of a reach it is certain; out to the reach it takes the roll, once a look; a little beyond it, a glimpse on a high roll

receiver.is: receiver for radio and radar emissions

animal.is: an animal the size of a dog or a deer

heavy.is: a lorry, a tank or other heavy vehicle

structure.is: a building or other fixed structure

air.note: thick is smoke made to blind thermal sights as well as eyes, such as his own

light.note: only the cameras care; night is moon or street light, dark is neither

cover.note: partial is in a hedge, a doorway or a window; thin is behind a light wall or inside a vehicle's skin, which thermal and radar read through at a quarter strength and only at short range; hidden is behind a solid wall or underground

hot.means: engine running, or only just stopped

loud.means: an engine at work, shots, shouting

quiet.means: trying not to be found: engine off, or masked

emitting.means: using a radio, a radar or a control link

silent.why: silent running: nothing that sends out a signal is on, so radar and lidar are off

smoke.why: inside his own smoke: it blinds his cameras, his thermal imager and his lidar as it blinds everyone's; radar and microphones still work

veil.why: the Veil is up: it does not dim his own sensors

port.tells: what the sample is made of (a fuel, an oil, a coolant, water, soil, a metal, a fibre), and whether it is flammable, corrosive or toxic
port.not: where it came from, or who handled it
port.rule: one sample at a time, put in by hand
